name: Imperial Capital
desc: Here, lies the absolute comamnd of the Terran Empire. Orders leave this location and are broadcast to officers across the interstellar empire. (Though not all orders are followed in such an Imperial enviroment). The power of Earth is held in a single hand and dispersed amongst the lower ranks to ensure that the orders of the Emperor are followed. Attempts to conquer this capital will result in a quick death, not of loyalty but the sheer pride in the supremacy of humanity over all else.
